name: Regulatory Registration
description: Authority, alerting, document generation and validation defaults for the Regulatory Registration toolkit.

settings.label: Default regulatory authority
settings.description: Authority applied to new registrations when none is chosen.

settings.label: Enable document expiry alerts
settings.description: Notify when documents and registrations are close to expiry.

settings.label: Expiry alert days
settings.description: How many days before expiry the alert is sent.

settings.label: Enable PDF generation
settings.description: Generate dossiers, cover letters and certificates. Requires the PDFKit npm package.

settings.label: Enable Excel export
settings.description: Export registration data and reports to Excel. Requires the ExcelJS npm package.

settings.label: Enable INCI validation
settings.description: Validate ingredient names against the INCI standard.

settings.label: Enable HS code validation
settings.description: Validate Harmonized System codes used for import and export classification.

settings.label: Enable API sync
settings.description: Sync registration status directly with authority APIs. Requires API credentials.

settings.label: Auto-generate product code
settings.description: Assign a unique product code to new products automatically.

settings.label: Product code prefix
settings.description: Prefix for generated product codes, for example REG-2024-001.
